name: 瓦莱里奥·维斯托索
name_full: 瓦莱里奥·维斯托索 Valerio Vestoso

last_movies.title: Vita Da Carlo Stagione Finale Season 3
Vita da Carlo Te Terza Stagione

introduction: Director and screenwriter, Vestoso made his debut in short films with Tacco 12, a mockumentary about the obsession with group dancing. In 2016 he wrote the show Buena Onda with Rocco Papaleo and Giovanni Esposito, won the Solinas Prize - Bottega delle Serie with the screenplay Flash, and directed numerous branded content and TV commercials. He is the author of a film about the surreal musician Enzo Savastano (Satira Prize, Musicultura Critics' Prize), director of the short film Ratzinger Vuole Tornare (in selection at the Nastri d'Argento), and the documentary Essere Gigione, dedicated to the king of Italian street parties. In 2019, he directed the video content of Serena Dandini's programme Stati Generali and wrote the script for the series Vincenzo Malinconico, avvocato d'insuccesso, based on the novels by Diego De Silva. He wrote for the TV show Una pezza di Lundini. In 2021, his short film Le Buone Maniere was presented in the official selection at Alice nella Città. He directed the series Vita da Carlo 2 with Carlo Verdone for Paramount Plus and the series No Activity on Amazon Prime in 2024.
